_readme: Accessibility findings that are known and not yet fixed. Keyed by rule@normalised-selector;
see tests/support/a11y.mjs for why the selector is normalised and why this file can only shrink.
Every entry needs a note saying what it costs a user, and an issue tracking the fix. An entry
without both is rejected when the file loads — a finding silenced for no recorded reason is the
same as one nobody looked at.
Regenerate with: npm run test:a11y:record   (then write the notes; the placeholders fail)

button-name@.MuiButtonBase-root-MuiIconB.note: An icon button with no discernible text: a screen reader announces it as "button" and nothing else. Same class as log entry #14 — an unlabelled control on the page teachers use to enter grades.

list@.MuiList-padding.note: MUI List renders a <ul> containing something other than <li>, so assistive technology either loses the item count or does not announce it as a list. May be MUI default markup rather than ours — check before changing our tree.

list@.MuiList-root.note: MUI List renders a <ul> containing something other than <li>, so assistive technology either loses the item count or does not announce it as a list. May be MUI default markup rather than ours — check before changing our tree.

nested-interactive@.MuiTableCell-root:nt.note: Sortable column headers nest interactive controls. Focus order, what is announced, and what activation does are all browser-dependent — and it is directly in the way of sorting a grade table by keyboard.
